name: 🍝 Spinach & Cottage Cheese Baked Pasta
what: Pasta, marinara and a creamy cheese layer baked until bubbly.

core.name: Rao's marinara
core.out: any jar of sauce we have

extras: baby spinach, an egg, parmesan, garlic, italian seasoning

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 400°F, pasta water on.
Boil the pasta 2 minutes less than the box says. Wilt the spinach with garlic while it boils.
Mix the cottage cheese, egg and parmesan. Fold in pasta, spinach, most of the sauce and half the mozzarella.
Into a 9×13. Rest of the sauce and cheese on top.
Bake until bubbly, broil 2 minutes for brown spots. Rest 5.

key: Undercook the pasta by 2 minutes. It finishes in the oven.
done: Bubbling all over with brown spots on the cheese.
plan_b: No time to bake? Toss the pasta with sauce, cottage cheese and spinach in the pot and serve.
